content:
BUILT CoLAB, as a member of DIGITALbuilt – Digital Innovation Hub, offers services at competitive prices that promote innovation, digitalisation and sustainability in the Built Environment.

Accessing these services allows SMEs operating in the AEC sector and public administration bodies to find competitively priced solutions as they include co-funding from the PRR and the European Union.

The services provided by BUILT CoLAB range from BIM and ACV Training, to BIM Implementation, Nature-Based Solutions planning and Programming in the AEC sector, as well as Digital Maturity Diagnosis, BIM Implementation Pathway Assessment, BIM Productivity Tools Assessment, AR/VR, Laser Scanning, Digital Twins, IoT, AI, Customised Software Development (up to MVP), and Customised Digital Twin Development.

Find out all the information here and contact us by filling in this form to find out how to access these services.
